Experience desktop-caliber performance in a stunning 2-in-1 design. The OnexPlayer Super X seamlessly blends the raw power of the latest AMD architecture with the versatility of a detachable tablet, redefining productivity, creation, and entertainment on your terms.

Who are Jamie's Computers?
The Society of St James (SSJ) , trading as Jamie's Computers , is a UK registered charity. SSJ is a Southampton-based homelessness charity, providing a range of supported living services in Southampton, Portsmouth and across Hampshire. We provide a wide range of support to people from all walks of life experiencing homelessness, problematic alcohol or substance use and mental health problems.
Set up by SSJ in 2002, Jamies helps recycle all kinds of IT and computer equipment, both professionally and ethically. We're located in Southampton. 70% of donated equipment is reused, recycled and upcycled to Microsoft standards. The rest is broken down into components and recycled, meaning that 0% of material goes to landfill. We also provide volunteering opportunities to give individuals the chance to learn practical skills in a real business environment.
Payment
Jamie's computers only accepts payments through eBay for items purchased on eBay. Items sold through auction must be paid for within 30 days. After 30 days the item is then offered to the next highest bidder.
Shipping
Jamie's Computers will only accept orders with a UK mainland shipping address. We aim to ship all items within 3 working days of payment using DHL, Royal Mail or FedEx. We do not ship items over the weekends. Items may be collected from our storefront on weekdays between 09:00 and 16:00 by arrangement. Please ensure you bring your eBay collection code with you.
VAT Invoices
Jamie's Computers is the trading arm of The Society of St James, a registered charity. Under UK tax law, charities are entitled to a specific VAT relief known as "zero-rating" on the sale of donated goods. Because the items we sell were donated to us for the purpose of fundraising, the VAT rate applied to these sales is 0%. Since no VAT is actually charged on the transaction, we cannot provide an invoice showing a standard 20% VAT amount. This government relief is designed to ensure that 100% of your purchase price goes directly toward supporting our mission rather than being diverted to tax.
Returns
All returns must be conducted via eBay, we cannot organise returns via email or any other channel.
- Under the Consumer Rights Act 2015 an online buyer has the right to return an item within 14 days of receiving the item. Under these conditions please initiate a return through eBay, using the "I just don't like it" option. The buyer will pay postage for this return and eBay will automatically refund the buyer once the item arrives back with us.
- Under the eBay Money Back Guarantee, a buyer has 30 calendar days from the actual or last estimated delivery date to initiate a "Significantly Not As Described" (SNAD) return. Under these conditions please select the appropriate option during the returns process, either " Item arrived damaged", "Item doesn't match description/photos" or "Wrong item sent". We will pay the postage for this return and eBay will refund the buyer once the item arrives back with us.
Under both sets of conditions, please ensure the item arrives back with us in the same condition we shipped it. If the item is not in the same condition we must open a case against the buyer for the return.

Cores and Threads Explained
Cores :
These are the physical components within the CPU that perform actual
processing tasks. Having more cores generally means better performance and
the ability to handle more tasks simultaneously.
Threads :
Threads are the smallest sequence of programmed instructions that can be
managed independently by a scheduler. With technologies like
Hyper-Threading (by Intel) or Simultaneous Multi-Threading (by AMD), each
physical core can handle two threads, effectively doubling the number of
tasks the CPU can manage at once.
Why It Matters
Performance :
More cores and threads improve multitasking and performance, especially
for tasks like video editing, gaming, or running multiple applications
simultaneously.
Efficiency :
It allows the CPU to distribute tasks more efficiently, reducing
bottlenecks and improving overall system responsiveness.
Think of it like having 6 chefs (cores) in a kitchen, each
capable of handling two dishes (threads) at the same time. So, your kitchen can
work on 12 dishes simultaneously, improving the efficiency of your culinary
operation!

listings.description:
We collect these units and bring them to our asset recovery facility where we work our IT magic! Your refurbished item was originally owned by a large corporation or agency. Depending on what one you buy….
Store Categories
All of our items are rigorously tested and fully functional.
Weekday orders paid by 12 noon are dispatched same day.
Weekend orders will be dispatched on Monday.
If you need your order fast, next day delivery is available at checkout.
Product Gallery
Description
Rigorously tested and guaranteed fully functional. Our grades are; Platinum - Practically Perfect, Gold - Minor signs of use, Silver - Obvious signs of use, Bronze - well used.
About MDT
MyDigitalTech is the retail branch of one of the world’s largest electronics reuse and recycling companies, for refurbishing and disposing of their surplus IT and telecoms equipment.
Our stock comes from the companies and agencies who bought top-quality new stock and kept it well maintained. We collect these units and bring them to our asset recovery facility where we work our IT magic! First we data wipe the equipment, ensuring that it no longer contains any data from a former user. They are then put through a rigorous testing programme before being cleaned inside and out.
Finally, as one of only a handful of Microsoft Authorized Refurbishers in the UK, we install a genuine Windows operating system on all compatible products.
Now, your equipment is ready to use as soon as you open the box.
If you have any queries regarding our eBay store or any of the information or materials contained on or in it, please contact us.
Our Grading Explained
NEW SEALED - Exactly what it says - an unused item in a sealed box.
NEW OPEN - The item is still unused, but the box has been opened. All original accessories are included.
PLATINUM - Just as you’d expect from an item bearing a Platinum badge- virtually indistinguishable from new. No marks, no scuffs, no blemishes, no scratches, and no dents!
GOLD - Gold units almost made the top grade, but fell just short. Not that you can easily tell. These units will show minor signs of use, but are excellent value for money.
SILVER - If you want functionality and low cost, then our Silver units are perfect for you. These items have the functionality of their Gold and Platinum counterparts, but with a much lower price tag. They do show obvious signs of use, though- scratches, scuffs or dents might be visible.
BRONZE - The best price available, and fully functional, but will look a little rough.
Shipping
At MyDigitalTech, we do everything possible to get your order to you as quickly and safely as possible. Orders are dispatched within one business day, and we offer free delivery to most areas of the UK through our couriers. International orders are trackable through the courriers website, priced economy 3+ days for best value for money and insured.
Product FAQs
I am buying “refurbished” kit. What does that mean?
Our refurbished equipment isn’t brand new, it just looks and operates that way. Your refurbished item was originally owned by a large corporation or agency. Our parent company Sims Lifecycle Services, contracts to take that equipment and completely wipe it of all existing data. Then they pass the equipment over to MyDigitalTech. We take the equipment, thoroughly clean it inside and output it through an enhanced test to ensure that it’s good for sale. Where applicable, we’ll install a new operating system and deliver it to you ready to use straight out of the box.
What can a new computer do that a refurbished one can’t?
Depending on what one you buy….Nothing! Refurbished laptops and desktops are great for browsing the Internet, home office work and watching streaming movies and television, some of them are even powerful enough to run large programmes like Photoshop. By choosing a refurbished computer you are getting a great piece of equipment at a bargain price.
Will my computer arrive ready to use?
Yes! We are a Microsoft Authorized Refurbisher, so your computer will arrive installed with a genuine Windows operating system.
Do you also sell new items?
Yes, we do. New items come from the same companies and distributors that supply the stock we refurbish. New items will arrive in their unopened, original packaging.
Why do some of the same products have different prices?
We have a large stock of products that come in different conditions. We grade them as platinum, gold and silver so that you know their cosmetic condition. Platinum products are virtually indistinguishable from new, gold products show minor signs of use and silver products might show visible scratches, scuffs or dents. The products are priced accordingly.
Why should I buy refurbished instead of new stock?
Refurbished stock is excellent value for money. You are getting great products from top manufacturers, with genuine Microsoft operating systems (where applicable) and cleaned like new for a fraction of the price of new equipment.
Where do the products come from?
Our stock started out as IT equipment being used by agencies or large companies. It has been used for a limited period of time and well maintained. Our parent group, Sims Lifecycle Services, has contracts to refurbish and redistribute this equipment, providing us with a great variety of quality products.

Advanced Cooling and Comprehensive Connectivity
Built for sustained high performance, the Erazer Defender 17 features an advanced cooling system that efficiently manages heat generated by the processor and graphics card during intensive gaming sessions. Intelligent thermal management helps maintain stable performance while minimising thermal throttling, allowing you to game and create for longer with confidence. A wide selection of connectivity options, including USB ports, HDMI, Ethernet, Wi-Fi, Bluetooth, and audio connections, provides excellent flexibility for connecting gaming accessories, external monitors, storage devices, and other peripherals.

Introducing the ROG Strix G18
Reach new heights of Windows 11 Gaming performance with the Strix G18, featuring 13th Gen Intel® Core™ i9-13980HX Processor and an NVIDIA® GeForce RTX™ 4070 Laptop GPU and a dedicated MUX Switch with NVIDIA Advanced Optimus. Sporting all new 16- and 18-inch Nebula displays and full-surround vents with Tri-Fan Technology, the 2023 ROG Strix G18 are here to change the way you game.
Power up your play
Draw more frames and win more games with the brand new Strix G and Windows 11 Home. Powered by a 13th Gen Intel® Core™ i9-13980HX Processor and an NVIDIA GeForce RTX 4070 Laptop GPU with Dynamic Boost, be ready to dominate the competition in all of the latest games. Backed up with a dedicated MUX Switch and NVIDIA Advanced Optimus, the Strix G unlocks the true potential of its hardware. With 1TB PCIe Gen4x4 SSD storage and 32GB of 4800MHz DDR5 RAM, large game libraries and intense multitasking sessions are a breeze for this gaming machine.
ROG Intelligent Cooling
To accommodate such powerful components, the Strix G's chassis and motherboard were both redesigned to accommodate our new full-width heatsink, whose fins were moved even closer to the exhaust vents for more efficient cooling. The full-width heatsink is built from three different sections, surrounding the motherboard with densely-packed fins for a total surface area of 174,183-195,509mm², up to 92% increase from the 2022 Strix G series. This design maximizes the available pathing for hot air to escape the machine and drastically increases overall airflow.
Finally, most gaming laptops have a dual fan cooling system, but the Strix G was able to push the performance envelope even further with the introduction of a third fan that helps keep the GPU and VRAM cool. Paired with seven heatpipes and Conductonaut Extreme liquid metal on both the CPU and GPU* the Strix G's cooling system is a marvel of engineering.
ROG Nebula Display
You can't beat the enemy if you don't see them coming. The Strix G has ultra-fast panel options for every scenario, making sure you'll never miss a moment. For the first time ever, this 18-inch machine offer QHD+ 240Hz Nebula displays. A 16:10 panel with 500 nits of brightness, 100% DCI-P3 coverage and 3ms response times, the Strix G has pixel-perfect precision even in the most frenetic firefights. The Strix G is also available with a Full HD 165Hz panel, with each option offering fantastic color, Dolby Vision, G-Sync support, and an 89% screen-to-body ratio for a stellar gaming and viewing experience.
Built for victory.
The Republic of Gamers was built by those who love to play video games. All ROG designs come with gamers in mind, from the chassis, lighting integration, software controls, and macro functions. These ROG exclusive design features not only give you a competitive advantage, but they make sure you never blend in with the crowd.
Studio-quality Sound
Dual Dolby Atmos-powered speakers create an authentic sound stage for your games. Hi-Res audio ensures you hear your music in the same quality it was recorded. Two-Way AI Noise Cancelation processes both incoming and outgoing audio to filter any errant background noises, making sure that your calls, chats and streams come through without distraction.
All Day Endurance
The Strix G is ready to go the distance. Featuring a 90Wh battery, the laptop can easily browse the web for hours away from the wall before needing a recharge. For flexibility on the go, USB Type-C charging is supported up to 100W. When charging using the supplied 330W power adapter, the Strix G can recharge from zero to 50% in just 30 minutes.
Stay Connected
When you need to plug into the big screen, the dedicated GPU powers an HDMI 2.1 port for the latest TVs and monitors, increasing total bandwidth from 18 to 48Gbps, and supporting up to 4K 120Hz and 8K 60Hz content. Two USB Type-C ports allow for plenty of connectivity-one for DisplayPort and power delivery, and a second with Thunderbolt 4 support.
The 13th Gen Intel Core i9-13980HX processor clocked at 2.2 GHz (up to 5.6 GHz in Boost Mode) with 24 cores (8 P cores and 16 E cores) delivers exceptional performance for a smooth, responsive computing experience. The NVIDIA GeForce RTX 4070 TGP 140W graphics card delivers exceptional graphics performance for gaming and graphics-intensive tasks. With NVIDIA Advanced Optimus, the laptop can automatically route frames from the discrete GPU directly to the display using a MUX switch, bypassing the integrated graphics. This pathing improves performance by 5-10% compared to machines without a MUX Switch, making sure you get the absolute best gaming experience--all without needing touch a single button. This automatic switching also preserves your machine's battery life, as it can dynamically transition between the high-power discrete GPU and the lower power integrated GPU. The combination of high resolution, 240Hz refresh rate and G-SYNC makes it exceptionally well suited to fast-paced gaming, while the excellent colour coverage also makes it attractive for creative and visual work.
One of the areas where the Alienware x16 R2 really stands out is its sound system . The audio experience is exceptionally impressive for a laptop, with Dolby Atmos audio professionally tuned for Alienware . It produces a surprisingly rich and immersive sound experience for a relatively slim gaming machine, putting it into the sort of category normally associated with premium machines such as the MacBook Pro and high-end ASUS ROG Zephyrus/ProArt systems . Whether gaming, watching films or simply listening to music, the speakers are a particularly enjoyable part of the experience.
The design is unmistakably Alienware . The Lunar Silver chassis has a distinctive, futuristic Alienware aesthetic without looking like a conventional bulky gaming laptop. Despite packing an RTX 4080 and high-end cooling hardware, the x16 R2 remains relatively slim and surprisingly portable for this level of performance . The customisation is also extensive, with per-key AlienFX RGB lighting , plus configurable lighting across the keyboard, touchpad, Alienware logo and rear I/O/port area , allowing you to create a very distinctive setup.

Air is drawn into the system from the topside around the keyboard area and expelled through the sides and rear , creating a dedicated airflow path through the machine.

ASUS have also added a brand new ACR (Ambient Contrast Ratio) film, with two layers that cut down on glare to increase contrast for more vibrant visuals, as well as improving off-angle viewing for when you might have a spectator.
ACR Technology
This year, ASUS even added two layers of Ambient Contrast Ratio film to the display, which reduces reflections by 55% and provides up to 4.5x better contrast, ensuring the image stays punchy, vivid, and accurate. A second layer boosts viewing angle for a 180° ultra-clear view, providing an image that looks just as good off-center as it does straight on. This machine doesn't just perform at a high level – it draws you into the visuals, with colours so realistic it’s as if you were right in the middle of the action.
A Breath of Fresh Air
The cooling solution of the 2025 Strix G16 has also undergone a redseign, to ensure that you get the best gaming experience with your machine, every time. ASUS have relocated all of the exhaust vents to the rear of the hinge, keeping warm air away from your mousing hand. The sides and bottom of the machine act as an air intake, creating a natural, efficient path for airflow. Air also flows through the keyboard deck, keeping your hands cooler during intense gaming sessions. When pairing an end-to-end vapor chamber with a sandwiched heatsink, Tri-Fan Technology, and Conductonaut Extreme liquid metal on both CPU & GPU, the 2025 Strix G16 achieves a lower noise level in Turbo Mode compared to the previous generation, while still offering the same calculated excellence you expect from a Strix machine.

Dominate the Windows 11 Pro battlefield with the ROG Strix SCAR 18. Power, meet efficiency
Power through any game or project with an Intel® Core™ i9 Processor 14900HX, featuring up to a 65W TDP and a hybrid architecture built from the ground up for Windows 11 Pro. With NVIDIA® Advanced Optimus, the laptop can automatically route frames from the discrete GPU directly to the display using a MUX switch, bypassing the integrated graphics. This pathing improves performance 5-10% compared to machines without a MUX Switch, making sure you get the absolute best gaming experience—all without needing touch a single button. This automatic switching also preserves your machine's battery life, as it can dynamically transition between the high power discrete GPU and the lower power integrated GPU. No matter what you’re doing, your machine will switch to the most optimized mode without you having to lift a finger.

Featuring up to an Intel® Core™ i9 processor and up to an NVIDIA® GeForce RTX™ 40 Series Laptop GPU, complex projects on popular development tools like Unity and Autodesk render in a snap. You have what it takes to be the best on the battlefield, but are you ready to design the next one?
ROG Intelligent Cooling
To accommodate such powerful components, the Strix SCAR 18’s chassis and motherboard were both redesigned to accommodate our new full-width heatsink, while the copper fins were moved even closer to the exhaust vents for more efficient cooling. This unique heatsink is built from three different sections, surrounding the motherboard with densely packed fins for a total surface area of 195,509mm², a 82.5% increase from the 2022 Strix SCAR 17. This design maximizes the available pathing for hot air to escape the machine and drastically increases overall cooling. The signature ROG gaming design, premium keyboard, and robust construction provide both comfort and durability for long hours of competitive gaming and everyday use.
Windows 11 Gaming with Premium ROG Experience

FOR THE NEXT ERA OF GAMING

COMPETE AT WARP SPEED

VECTOR HEAT PIPES

A Signature Look That Stands Out

UNBOUND SPEED AND CONNECTION

CONTROL WITH PREDATORSENSE AND EXPERIENCE ZONE

Standard VAT and VAT margin scheme explained
The standard VAT scheme is charged at 20%, where an eligible VAT registered UK business may be able to claim this back. EU customers: we are unable to zero-rate VAT through this listing.
The VAT margin scheme is frequently used for second-hand and refurbished goods. Where the margin scheme applies, the price you see includes VAT, but VAT cannot be claimed back or displayed separately on the invoice.

If you are a consumer buying for personal use, it does not affect you. The price you see is the price you pay. If you are a VAT registered business, or another organisation that could normally claim back VAT on eligible purchases, you will not be able to claim back VAT on goods sold under the VAT margin scheme.

Description
Rigorously tested and guaranteed fully functional. Our grades are; Platinum - Practically Perfect, Gold - Minor signs of use, Silver - Obvious signs of use, Bronze - well used.
About MDT
MyDigitalTech is the retail branch of one of the world’s largest electronics reuse and recycling companies, for refurbishing and disposing of their surplus IT and telecoms equipment.
Our stock comes from the companies and agencies who bought top-quality new stock and kept it well maintained. We collect these units and bring them to our asset recovery facility where we work our IT magic! First we data wipe the equipment, ensuring that it no longer contains any data from a former user. They are then put through a rigorous testing programme before being cleaned inside and out.
Finally, as one of only a handful of Microsoft Authorized Refurbishers in the UK, we install a genuine Windows operating system on all compatible products.
Now, your equipment is ready to use as soon as you open the box.
If you have any queries regarding our eBay store or any of the information or materials contained on or in it, please contact us.
Our Grading Explained
NEW SEALED - Exactly what it says - an unused item in a sealed box.
NEW OPEN - The item is still unused, but the box has been opened. All original accessories are included.
PLATINUM - Just as you’d expect from an item bearing a Platinum badge- virtually indistinguishable from new. No marks, no scuffs, no blemishes, no scratches, and no dents!
GOLD - Gold units almost made the top grade, but fell just short. Not that you can easily tell. These units will show minor signs of use, but are excellent value for money.
SILVER - If you want functionality and low cost, then our Silver units are perfect for you. These items have the functionality of their Gold and Platinum counterparts, but with a much lower price tag. They do show obvious signs of use, though- scratches, scuffs or dents might be visible.
BRONZE - The best price available, and fully functional, but will look a little rough.
Shipping
At MyDigitalTech, we do everything possible to get your order to you as quickly and safely as possible. Orders are dispatched within one business day, and we offer free delivery to most areas of the UK through our couriers. International orders are trackable through the courriers website, priced economy 3+ days for best value for money and insured.
Product FAQs
I am buying “refurbished” kit. What does that mean?
Our refurbished equipment isn’t brand new, it just looks and operates that way. Your refurbished item was originally owned by a large corporation or agency. Our parent company Sims Lifecycle Services, contracts to take that equipment and completely wipe it of all existing data. Then they pass the equipment over to MyDigitalTech. We take the equipment, thoroughly clean it inside and output it through an enhanced test to ensure that it’s good for sale. Where applicable, we’ll install a new operating system and deliver it to you ready to use straight out of the box.
What can a new computer do that a refurbished one can’t?
Depending on what one you buy….Nothing! Refurbished laptops and desktops are great for browsing the Internet, home office work and watching streaming movies and television, some of them are even powerful enough to run large programmes like Photoshop. By choosing a refurbished computer you are getting a great piece of equipment at a bargain price.
Will my computer arrive ready to use?
Yes! We are a Microsoft Authorized Refurbisher, so your computer will arrive installed with a genuine Windows operating system.
Do you also sell new items?
Yes, we do. New items come from the same companies and distributors that supply the stock we refurbish. New items will arrive in their unopened, original packaging.
Why do some of the same products have different prices?
We have a large stock of products that come in different conditions. We grade them as platinum, gold and silver so that you know their cosmetic condition. Platinum products are virtually indistinguishable from new, gold products show minor signs of use and silver products might show visible scratches, scuffs or dents. The products are priced accordingly.
Why should I buy refurbished instead of new stock?
Refurbished stock is excellent value for money. You are getting great products from top manufacturers, with genuine Microsoft operating systems (where applicable) and cleaned like new for a fraction of the price of new equipment.
Where do the products come from?
Our stock started out as IT equipment being used by agencies or large companies. It has been used for a limited period of time and well maintained. Our parent group, Sims Lifecycle Services, has contracts to refurbish and redistribute this equipment, providing us with a great variety of quality products.
What comes in the box?
This varies by product. Review product descriptions for specific details for what is included in your purchase.
As you shop, we will also make suggestions for additional pieces you might want to purchase to enhance your kit. For example, desktop computers will come with a power cord, but not a keyboard or mouse
What comes installed?
Computer equipment will come with a genuine Microsoft Operating System. The specific Operating System will be detailed within the product listing. You’ll be asked to activate this by entering the unique product key (found on COA sticker; exmple below) when you first …

Loaded Software
Here at CPR, we don't believe in loading loads of software onto a new laptop (AKA Bloatware). Only the operating system and brand-related apps are downloaded. The Office 365 app can be installed directly from the Microsoft store or website.
Battery Condition
Battery life can vary significantly depending on usage. Laptops will always use more power when a DVD is playing or a game than just surfing the internet or answering emails. To this end, predicting an accurate life expectancy is difficult. However, to help, we test and grade batteries for laptops by real-life scenarios in that once fully refurbished, all laptops are specification checked (which involves running software on the machine for about 20 minutes). Browsing history and testing files removed using other software. At this point, the battery percentage is checked and noted above our opinion of the battery. On top of this, we use software (batteryinfoview) to verify this information and gain the percentage of health. Hopefully, this will give you a guide to the condition. Should you wish to purchase a new battery, these are very cheap and can extend your battery life (stock dependent).
Before we dispatch any Laptop:
Safety and security are important to us. Before any computer is shipped, we will have cleansed the hard drive, including previous boot sectors, thus eliminating any previously installed software. Following this, every computer is scanned at a deep level, Looking for all known viruses, including spyware and adware. Then and only then will a PC be reinstalled with the appropriate operating system and refurbished for sale.
Warranty
Here at CPR, we offer a 3-month warranty with all desktop and laptop computers over £250 and sold as refurbished. The first 30 days are parts and labour service, with the remaining time being labour only. This service is a back-to-base, with the cost of returning an item being the customer's responsibility. Once a machine has been refurbished, it goes through extensive testing to ensure no hidden problems are there. As such, we are confident that the computers we sell are of excellent quality and reliability when shipped. In the unlikely event you face issues with your purchase, contact us VIA the 'contact seller' button on eBay.

Performance designed for you - Powered by 12th Gen Intel Core vPro processors—with up to 12 cores—the ThinkPad X1 Yoga Gen 7 2-in-1 laptop takes multitasking to the next level. More accommodating than a concierge - Thanks to its 360-degree hinge, the ThinkPad X1 Yoga Gen 7 convertible laptop quickly switches between laptop, tablet, tent, and stand modes. Simply subscribe to the Tile service, and then download, set up, and activate.
Tested to withstand the extremes - We use the US Department of Defense's MIL-STD 810H standards to create a balance of reliability and durability for our ThinkPad laptops. Description
Powerful Processing for Seamless Performance
The Acer Nitro V 17 AI ANV17-41 is engineered to provide outstanding performance with its AMD Ryzen 7 260 processor. Running at a base frequency of 3.8 GHz, this laptop delivers efficient multitasking and processing power, ensuring smooth operation for gaming, content creation, and productivity tasks. Whether you're handling demanding applications or immersive gaming, this processor offers the speed and reliability needed for a seamless experience.
Expansive and Immersive Full HD Display
Boasting a 17.3-inch Full HD display with a resolution of 1920 x 1080 pixels, the Nitro V 17 AI provides vivid visuals and exceptional clarity. The 43.9 cm screen enhances gaming and multimedia experiences with sharp details and rich colors. Whether you're engaging in high-resolution gaming or streaming content, this display offers an immersive view that brings every scene to life.
High-Speed Memory and Reliable Storage
With 16 GB of DDR5-SDRAM, this laptop ensures smooth multitasking and rapid data processing. The high-performance memory allows users to switch between applications effortlessly, making it ideal for gamers and professionals. The 1 TB SSD storage provides ultra-fast data access, allowing quick boot-ups, file transfers, and application loading times. This combination of speed and storage offers an optimized computing experience.
Advanced Graphics for Exceptional Gaming
Equipped with the NVIDIA GeForce RTX 5070, the Nitro V 17 AI delivers stunning graphics and high frame rates for an exceptional gaming experience. The discrete graphics card enhances visual fidelity, supporting real-time ray tracing and AI-powered rendering for lifelike graphics. Whether you're playing the latest AAA titles or working on complex design projects, the RTX 5070 ensures top-tier performance.
Sleek Design and Modern Functionality
Designed in a sleek black clamshell form factor, the Nitro V 17 AI combines aesthetics with durability. Its sophisticated build offers a balance of style and practicality, making it a great choice for gamers and professionals. Running on Windows 11 Home, this laptop provides a modern and intuitive interface with enhanced security and productivity features. Whether for work or entertainment, Windows 11 ensures a streamlined and user-friendly experience.

Enjoy robust performance on the ThinkPad P16s Gen 3 (16” Intel) mobile workstation driven by the Intel® Core™ Ultra processor. Your Workstation, Your Way, Everywhere
Juggle tasks like a pro with the P16s Gen 3 mobile workstation. It boasts plentiful ports, swift memory, and superior connectivity with WiFi capabilities and optional WWAN technology to stay online 24/7. Delivering robust performance at an affordable cost, this device is ideal for architects, engineers, and 2D and entry-level 3D creators alike.
Clarity — With Capabilities, Without Compromise
Whether you’re creating content or editing designs, the P16s Gen 3 workstation delivers supreme visual excellence with up to a 4K OLED display. Each display option features anti-glare and most are certified for low blue light. The Communication Bar on the screen top allows for seamless virtual interactions, boasting a 5MP camera and premium mics.
Efficiency in Action: Work Hard, Tread Lightly
To ensure steadfast performance for highly intensive tasks, the P16s Gen 3 workstation boasts independent software vendor (ISV) certified apps like Adobe®, ANSYS® , & AVID®. Feel the Difference: Smoother & Smarter
Our redesigned ThinkPad keyboard includes tactile markings for improved accessibility. The TrackPad is even bigger for greater control, and there’s a customizable TrackPoint Quick Menu — triggered with a double tap. Plus, multitask faster with a dedicated Windows Copilot key that streamlines your digital tasks, raising your everyday productivity.
Not Just Secure, A Virtual Stronghold
Benefit from ThinkShield, an advanced security suite, to encrypt data via a discrete Trusted Platform Module (dTPM). Get layered protection with the Intel® Hardware Shield powered by AI. And, gain quick, secure device access with fingerprint reader or facial recognition login features. Plus, its tested tough to comply with MIL-STD-810H standards.
Smart Performance
Lenovo Smart Performance will improve your computer experience! Inject more power into your computer to achieve smooth operation and blazingly quick starts. Advanced AMD Ryzen AI 9 Processing Power
Powered by the AMD Ryzen AI 9 processor, the ASUS ROG Zephyrus G14 delivers next-generation computing performance designed to support modern gaming and AI-assisted workflows. SSD technology significantly improves boot times, game loading speeds, file transfers, and application responsiveness compared to traditional storage solutions. The generous storage capacity offers ample space for large modern game libraries, productivity software, videos, and professional files while maintaining smooth and efficient system operation. This high-speed storage setup contributes to a seamless gaming and productivity experience throughout daily use.
Immersive 14-Inch 120Hz Display Experience
Featuring a premium 14-inch display with a fast 120Hz refresh rate, the ASUS ROG Zephyrus G14 delivers smooth visuals and responsive gameplay for modern gaming experiences. The high refresh rate helps reduce motion blur and improve fluidity during fast-paced gaming sessions, while the compact display size maintains excellent portability for users on the move. Sharp detail, vibrant colours, and clear visuals also make the display suitable for content creation, streaming, entertainment, and productivity tasks. The slim-bezel design enhances immersion while helping maximise screen space within the compact chassis.

The ASUS X415 laptop has been created with a 10th generation Intel i3
processor, 4GB RAM, a 14” Full HD NanoEdge display and a 128GB solid
state drive. This portable device, featuring an anti-glare coating –
reducing unwanted distractions from irritating glare and reflections,

Keep in contact
Thanks to its on-board HD camera and microphone, this device, once
connected to Wi-Fi, will let you to take part in video chats or virtual
meetings, enabling the fun to come to you.
Intel Core i3

browsing, emailing and even a spot of work.
The i3-1005G1 processor in this model features 4MB of cache and 2 cores
that can adjust their speed depending on the complexity of the task they

What is RAM?
RAM (Random Access Memory) is different to the permanent storage
provided by hard disk drives (HDD), solid state drives (SSD) or memory
cards in your equipment. RAM is used by your device to temporarily store
data to carry out everyday operations. The more RAM your machine has,
the faster you can expect it to open and run programs.
Day to day convenience
Featuring 4GB of RAM, this computer has enough power for tasks like web
browsing and word processing. You'll be able to run a couple of windows
at once without any obvious lag or slowdown.
Solid State Drive
Solid State Drives (SSD) give you the capacity to store your documents
and media, while ensuring quicker and reliable access to your files and
programs. SSDs are far faster than regular hard drives and ingeniously,
they don't use moving parts to work, which makes them far more
dependable and also quieter.
Intel UHD graphics

number of classic older games, along with some casual (web-based)
gaming. You may be able to run more modern titles with reduced effects
and frame rates.
Great entertainment

high-resolution photos, films and videos will be a pleasure. This device
has been designed to convey immersive images, and thanks to speakers
featuring ICEpower technology, will make for a enjoyable casual gaming
and multimedia experience.
Connecting your other devices
The USB ports allow for fast data transfer, whilst the HDMI port enables
the option for dual screen working (just connect a previously purchased
monitor, and then press the Windows button + P to select). The memory
card slot offers a convenient way to upload your photos and videos.
Additionally, Bluetooth can help to send data wirelessly between devices.

The laptop has not been disassembled beyond the removal of the bottom chassis cover.
Cosmetics & Casing: The chassis shows standard signs of handling, including a cracked/broken section of plastic on the rear corner exhaust vent and cracks on chassis visible on pictures. Several bottom cover screws are missing.

Memory: No RAM included (Motherboard features standard DDR5 SODIMM slots).

listings.title: *FAULTY* Acer Predator Helios NEO 16 AI Gaming Laptop RTX 5070 24GB RAM Ultra 7
listings.description:
This laptop has 24GB DDR5 RAM over the standard 16. Everything else is as it would be out the box and specs can be seen in photos. Bought from Currys end of September last year. Not fixed by Predator Sense's graphics/MUX mode switching (this actually triggered a black screen requiring an external monitor to recover).
This laptop has 24GB DDR5 RAM over the standard 16. Everything else is as it would be out the box and specs can be seen in photos. Bought from Currys end of September last year.
The laptop is in fantastic condition cosmetically . It has been extremely well looked after and still holding over 90% battery capacity.
THE FAULT:
The GPU vanishes and doesn’t show up. When it does appear it works on battery and plugged in but I tested on Fortnite and it crashes after about 30 mins. I’m led to believe it’s a minor issue due to age of laptop. It’s unfortunately stressing me out having the uncertainty of a non working laptop for example one night it works fine for around 2 hours on a game and then I load up in morning and GPU vanished. It’s also uncertain whether it will show up on battery or plugged in some days it shows on plugged in some days on battery some days both and then it often vanishes and has crashes and BSODs. Please also note that this is my rough analogy of the fault just from my limited testing abilities. THERE MAY BE OTHER FAULTS but this is all I could find from my testing.
via Windows Event Viewer: a Critical-level Kernel-Power Event ID 41 logs at the exact moment of the crash, indicating an unexpected loss of power rather than a software crash.
Have also had other things come up such as power state failure
Something like video dg fatal error
ALREADY TESTED:
Not a driver issue - the NVIDIA driver installer cannot detect the GPU at all when it's in this state, and a clean driver reinstall did not help.
Not a BIOS issue - already updated to the latest available BIOS (v1.28) from Acer's official support site.
Not fixed by Predator Sense's graphics/MUX mode switching (this actually triggered a black screen requiring an external monitor to recover).
Everything else - CPU, RAM, storage, display, keyboard, battery, charging, Wi-Fi - works completely normally. The laptop is fully usable on battery power for non-GPU-intensive tasks or when using the built in Intel graphics only.
PLEASE NOTE; SOLD AS SPARES SO NO RETURNS ACCEPTED. ONLY BUY IF YOU ARE OKAY WITH THE CHANCE OF NOT BEING ABLE TO FIX AND HAVING TO PAY FOR PROFESSIONAL REPAIR OR SELLING ON.
I did reach out to a local repair shop and they have approximated that it will be around £200 if it requires board repair however if it is anything less major such as a firmware issue etc then it will be much less.
Comes with original charger and box. Will be sent via special next day tracked signed for delivery. All serial numbers tracked. Any questions please ask.

We are UK based seller of PC accessories & components, aim to provide quality products and high quality standard customer service to our customers.
Payment
Parts4PC's only accept PayPal payments on purchased items. Payment must be received within 24 hours, otherwise we reserve the right to re-list the item.
Please ensure you check your shipping address upon checkout as we can only ship to this address. If you have made an error please contact us so we can cancel your order and attempt to help rectify the issue.
Shipping
All the items we advertise are in stock and are ready to be dispatched. We will dispatch all items within 1 working day of cleared payment. If your payment is received before 3.00pm we will endeavour to ship your item on the same day.
If you do not receive your order within 2 working days of the order dispatch date, please contact us so that we can trace the progress of the delivery.
The price quoted in the listing includes shipping within the UK and Northern Ireland. For any shipments outside the UK, please select the eBay Global Shipping Programme upon checkout.
Details can be found at the following address https://sellercentre.ebay.co.uk/using-global-shipping-programme
Returns
Goods are faulty on arrival:
If you find that your goods are faulty on arrival, then you are entitled to a replacement or a refund. Please note that you must contact us within 7 days of receipt of the order. In instances where we are unable to source a like-for-like replacement a refund will be issued.
Goods have become faulty during use
If your goods become faulty after delivery, and within the warranty period, then you are entitled to a repair or a replacement. Please note that in instances where we are unable to source a like-for-like replacement a refund will be issued.
Goods Damaged On Arrival
If you discover that your goods are visibly damaged on arrival, you should either write on the delivery note that the packaging is damaged, or refuse to accept the delivery. Please contact us within 48 hours with details of the damage. This will help us considerably in raising the matter with our courier. Once the damaged goods have been received back into our warehouse, then we will replace or refund them.
You Have Simply Changed Your Mind (Distance Selling Regulations)
If you have ordered goods from us, but then simply decided that you wish to cancel your order, you are entitled to do so and have any money that you have paid to us refunded. In order to return an unwanted item, the following criteria must be met:
- You must have contacted us in writing within 7 working days of receipt
- If the product is computer software or an audio/video recording it must be unopened.
- The item must be returned complete with ALL accessories and manuals / guides including free gifts
- The item must be in the original box and packaging It is your responsibility to return the goods to us in a safe and secure manner and at your cost.
How to Return Goods
Please contact us detailing the reason for the return, whether you would prefer a refund or a replacement and where applicable a description of the fault. We will contact you with an RMA (Returned Merchandise Authorisation) number.
Please ensure that your item is packaged suitably for transit and that you display the RMA number and returns address clearly on the exterior.
IMPORTANT: Once we've issued an RMA number, it's only valid for 28 DAYS. If we've not received the goods back after 28 days, the RMA number will no longer be valid. It's therefore important that you do send the goods back WITHIN 28 days of the RMA being issued.
